facts.activity_file: replacing seals and seal support fluid
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at ZV-7210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on ZV-7210 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. ZV-7210 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 6 December 2020 a potential incident was recorded on ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
